ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: The visible fluke surface exhibits a ratio of approximately 75% low-intensity (black) pixels to 25% high-intensity (white) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity bands are mapped along the upper trailing edges of both lobes. The right lobe contains a complex region of high-intensity mottling (spray pattern) extending from the upper edge toward the center. The left lobe features a more uniform, narrow high-intensity band at the top with isolated high-contrast spots in the lower dark field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A deep, narrow U-shaped depression at the center, characterized by high vertical depth relative to the width of the aperture.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The right lobe trailing edge shows high-amplitude, irregular serrations with deep jagged indentations. The left lobe trailing edge displays more frequent, lower-amplitude variations (finer peaks and valleys) along its linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer margins of both lobes follow a convex mathematical curve that terminates in sharp, tapered lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups (white spots) on the dark background, primarily concentrated on the right lobe's central and trailing regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the dark pigmented areas of both lobes, appearing as light gray diagonal streaks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant irregular notch/tissue loss area is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately midway between the center notch and the tip, indicating a major acquired injury.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique asymmetry in the trailing edge profile, where the right lobe possesses a much more jagged and traumatized contour than the left lobe.
